referenceDna.annotatedDescription: A wide calculator photograph sits under a dark scrim; white left copy shares the first viewport with a compact light consultation form at right. White horizontal row with square blue mark, simple pages and small phone/contact affordances. Plain sans headings and dense practical paragraphs, with uppercase blue actions and readable form labels. The page sequence runs from calculator hero with enquiry form to practice rationale to service pictogram strip toward how-accountants-help explainer, testimonial band, footer contact and form. Business paperwork photograph anchors the opening, followed by a document detail and a testimonial background. Only transferable composition, hierarchy and service-routing mechanics are retained.
